'''Athon Skims''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The son of [[Lynn Skims|Lynn]] and [[Doyle Skims]] and the brother of [[Lyda Skims]], Athon Skims served as a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AOFD" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Skims was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a delivery to Alliance contacts on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the time of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in retaliation for the Rebel activities of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. The devastating loss of Skims, and the subsequent death of their father at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], led his sister Lyda to join the Alliance, continuing their family's tradition of service under the code name "Skimmer".<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="AOFD" />
